parameters.name: DetectType
parameters.description:
The detection module. Valid values:
- **sqli**: SQL injection.
- **xss**: cross-site scripting (XSS).
- **cmdi**: OS command injection.
- **expression_injection**: expression injection.
- **java_deserialization**: Java deserialization.
- **dot_net_deserialization**: .NET deserialization.
- **php_deserialization**: PHP deserialization.
- **code_exec**: code execution.
- **ssrf**: server-side request forgery (SSRF).
- **path_traversal**: path traversal.
- **arbitrary_file_uploading**: arbitrary file upload.
- **webshell**: webshell.
- **rfilei**: remote file inclusion (RFI).
- **lfilei**: local file inclusion (LFI).
- **protocol_violation**: protocol violation.
- **scanner_behavior**: scanner behavior.
- **logic_flaw**: business logic bug.
- **arbitrary_file_reading**: arbitrary file read.
- **arbitrary_file_download**: arbitrary file download.
- **xxe**: XML external entity injection.
- **csrf**: cross-site request forgery.
- **crlf**: CRLF injection.
- **other**: other.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the returned rules. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 100. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: RiskLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. Valid values:

- **super_strict**: super strict.

- **strict**: strict.

- **medium**: medium.

- **loose**: loose.

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The rule action. Valid values:

- **block**: Block.

- **monitor**: Monitor.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the system protection rule to query.

parameters.name: RuleIds
parameters.description: The list of system protection rule IDs to query.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the system protection rule.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
The rule status. Valid values:
- **1**: disabled.
- **0**: enabled.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the protection template.

> 
> - You can set this parameter to query the system protection rules in a specific Web core protection rule template. Settings apply to the specified template.
> - If this parameter is left empty, the default configurations of system protection rules are queried.
